summary: Moses says now this is the commandment statutes ordinances Yahweh commanded to teach that you may fear Yahweh keep all statutes all days that days may be prolonged. Hear Israel Yahweh our God is one Yahweh, you shall love Yahweh your God with all heart soul might, these words which I command shall be on heart, you shall teach them diligently to children talk of them when sit in house walk by way lie down rise up, bind as sign on hand frontlets between eyes, write on doorposts and gates. When Yahweh brings into land great cities you didn't build... then beware lest you forget Yahweh who brought you from Egyptian house of bondage, fear Yahweh serve swear by name, not go after other gods, not test as at Massah, keep commandments diligently, do what is right and good that it may be well and you may go in possess good land, when son asks what mean testimonies statutes, you shall say we were Pharaoh's slaves Yahweh brought out with mighty hand with signs wonders before eyes and brought us out to give land he swore to fathers, Yahweh commanded to do all statutes to fear for our good always that he might preserve us alive as today, it shall be righteousness for us if we observe to do all commandment before Yahweh.
whyItMatters: Shema — Hear O Israel — most famous Jewish prayer, quoted by Jesus as greatest commandment. Central creed: Yahweh is one, love with all heart soul might, teach diligently, bind, write, plus warning not forget after prosperity and explaining to son why we keep law.

questions.question: What does Shema 'Hear O Israel Yahweh our God Yahweh is one' mean? Is it monotheism?
questions.answer: Shema = hear and obey. First line: Yahweh our God Yahweh one (ehad) — can mean Yahweh is one, or Yahweh alone, or Yahweh is one Yahweh (unique). Central creed of Jewish monotheism — Yahweh alone is God, no other, or Yahweh is indivisible unity. Jesus quotes as greatest commandment (Mark 12:29). Shema is daily prayer morning evening, with mezuzah and tefillin, covering heart soul might (might = me'od — muchness, strength, resources). Love with whole being.

questions.question: What does 'bind as sign on hand frontlets between eyes write on doorposts' mean? Literally?
questions.answer: On heart first (v6), then teach diligently children talk when sit house walk by way lie down rise up (conversation all day), bind as sign on hand (action) and frontlets between eyes (thought), write on doorposts and gates (home and city). Jews literalize: tefillin small boxes with Shema on arm and forehead, mezuzah on doorposts. Others see as metaphor: let words shape what hands do, what eyes see, what home displays. Either way: faith embodied, not just mental.

questions.question: Why warn 'when you have houses you didn't build beware lest you forget' and 'when son asks what mean'?
questions.answer: Moses anticipates prosperity after wilderness: land with cities you didn't build, houses full, cisterns, vineyards you didn't plant, you eat full — danger is forgetting Yahweh who brought from Egyptian house of bondage, going after other gods nearby. So command not to forget, and to explain to son when he asks what testimonies statutes mean: tell story first — we were slaves, Yahweh brought with mighty hand signs wonders, gave land swore to fathers, commanded statutes for our good to preserve alive, righteousness if observe. Story before statute, grace before law, for our good always.
